{{Top|leg|canon=Malligator}}
'''Maligators''' were [[Color/Legends|blue]]-scaled, alligator-like [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] of [[Trinta]] that had flat heads. Growing to be 2.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the creature used its spiked tail as a weapon.
